description: Ministry of Higher Education and Research - Order to amend the item 'Faculty of Social Sciences and Humanities' of the Rajarata University Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an amendment to a university's organizational structure under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It constitutes a statutory instrument (Order under Section 27(1)) that modifies the schedule of departments within the Faculty of Social Sciences and Humanities at Rajarata University. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing regulations rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
